about: The Gloria Patri is a short Trinitarian doxology. In the traditional Latin liturgy it concludes many psalms and canticles. In 529 the Second Council of Vaison prescribed in Gaul the form ending “Sicut erat in princípio…”.

s01.translation: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

s02.translation: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

w007.function: Agrees with “Spirítui” (w006). As an adjective of the first and second declensions, it has the dative form “Sancto”.

w009.function: Imperfect indicative with the understood subject “glória”.

w017.function: The preposition “in” with the accusative in the phrase “in sǽcula”: unto the ages.
